_config_notes.window_seconds: 300s (5 min) — was 600. Faster DGA detection, matches startup_lookback
_config_notes.ml_warmup_samples: 5000 — was 10000. Per-device model now activates in ~2.8h not 5.5h
_config_notes.baseline_alpha: 0.05 kept — correct EWMA speed for rate/entropy/unique
_config_notes.decay_factor: 0.995 kept — correct domain count half-life of ~4.6 min
_config_notes.poll_interval: 2s kept — optimal, Pi-hole DB is event-driven not time-driven
_config_notes.alert_threshold: 6.0 kept — well-calibrated after FP sensitivity fixes
_config_notes.home_subnet: 192.168.1.0/24 — matches the 192.168.1.94 safe_ips entry above. Update if your router's LAN differs.
_config_notes.geoip_asn_db: Empty = ASN/org metrics stay 'unknown' (same as before). Set a GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb path to enable them.
_config_notes.honeypot_ips: Deploy an unused IP address on your LAN (e.g. 192.168.1.200) running a fake SSH/SMB listener. Any device connecting to this IP receives an instant 10.0 Risk Score.
_config_notes.interactive_blocking_enabled: If true, Telegram alerts require manual operator approval before executing hardware isolations.
_config_notes.ips_router_enabled: Requires fritz_ip, fritz_user, and fritz_password to be configured for TR-064 API isolation.
_config_notes.fastapi_port: Port for the local IPC Uvicorn server to receive Telegram webhooks (default 8010).
